description: This file defines a function handleRetryLimitExhaustion which handles the scenario when retry limits are exhausted during an attempt to run an embedded Pi agent. It conditionally throws a FailoverError or returns a failure response, and imports types and functions related to failover handling.

methods.description: Handles retry limit exhaustion by either throwing a FailoverError or returning a failure payload. Takes parameters including message, decision, provider, model, profileId, durationMs, and agentMeta, and returns an EmbeddedPiRunResult.
